record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> upon Shoshannim<WH07799>, for the sons<WH01121> of Korah<WH07141>, Maschil<WH04905><WTH8688>, A Song<WH07892> of loves<WH03039>.<Fo><Fo> My heart<WH03820> is inditing<WH07370><WTH8804> a good<WH02896> matter<WH01697>: I speak<WH0559><WTH8802> of the things which I have made<WH04639> touching the king<WH04428>: my tongue<WH03956> <FI>is<Fi> the pen<WH05842> of a ready<WH04106> writer<WH05608><WTH8802>. <RF>Maschil: or, of instruction<Rf> <RF>is inditing: Heb. boileth, or, bubbleth up<Rf>

Thou art fairer<WH03302><WTH8795> than the children<WH01121> of men<WH0120>: grace<WH02580> is poured<WH03332><WTH8717> into thy lips<WH08193>: therefore God<WH0430> hath blessed<WH01288><WTH8765> thee for ever<WH05769>.
Gird<WH02296><WTH8798> thy sword<WH02719> upon <FI>thy<Fi> thigh<WH03409>, O <FI>most<Fi> mighty<WH01368>, with thy glory<WH01935> and thy majesty<WH01926>.

And in thy majesty<WH01926> ride<WH07392><WTH8798> prosperously<WH06743><WTH8798> because<WH01697> of truth<WH0571> and meekness<WH06037> <FI>and<Fi> righteousness<WH06664>; and thy right hand<WH03225> shall teach<WH03384><WTH8686> thee terrible things<WH03372><WTH8737>. <RF>ride...: Heb. prosper thou, ride thou<Rf>

Thine arrows<WH02671> <FI>are<Fi> sharp<WH08150><WTH8802> in the heart<WH03820> of the king's<WH04428> enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>; <FI>whereby<Fi> the people<WH05971> fall<WH05307><WTH8799> under thee.<CM>
Thy throne<WH03678>, O God<WH0430>, <FI>is<Fi> for ever<WH05769> and ever<WH05703>: the sceptre<WH07626> of thy kingdom<WH04438> <FI>is<Fi> a right<WH04334> sceptre<WH07626>.

Thou lovest<WH0157><WTH8804> righteousness<WH06664>, and hatest<WH08130><WTH8799> wickedness<WH07562>: therefore God<WH0430>, thy God<WH0430>, hath anointed<WH04886><WTH8804> thee with the oil<WH08081> of gladness<WH08342> above thy fellows<WH02270>.

All thy garments<WH0899> <FI>smell<Fi> of myrrh<WH04753>, and aloes<WH0174>, <FI>and<Fi> cassia<WH07102>, out of the ivory<WH08127> palaces<WH01964>, whereby<WH04482> they have made thee glad<WH08055><WTH8765>.
Kings<WH04428>' daughters<WH01323> <FI>were<Fi> among thy honourable women<WH03368>: upon thy right hand<WH03225> did stand<WH05324><WTH8738> the queen<WH07694> in gold<WH03800> of Ophir<WH0211>.<CM>

Hearken<WH08085><WTH8798>, O daughter<WH01323>, and consider<WH07200><WTH8798>, and incline<WH05186><WTH8685> thine ear<WH0241>; forget<WH07911><WTH8798> also thine own people<WH05971>, and thy father's<WH01> house<WH01004>;
So shall the king<WH04428> greatly desire<WH0183><WTH8691> thy beauty<WH03308>: for he <FI>is<Fi> thy Lord<WH0113>; and worship<WH07812><WTH8690> thou him.

And the daughter<WH01323> of Tyre<WH06865> <FI>shall be there<Fi> with a gift<WH04503>; <FI>even<Fi> the rich<WH06223> among the people<WH05971> shall intreat<WH02470><WTH8762> thy favour<WH06440>. <RF>favour: Heb. face<Rf>
The king's<WH04428> daughter<WH01323> <FI>is<Fi> all glorious<WH03520> within<WH06441>: her clothing<WH03830> <FI>is<Fi> of wrought<WH04865> gold<WH02091>.

She shall be brought<WH02986><WTH8714> unto the king<WH04428> in raiment of needlework<WH07553>: the virgins<WH01330> her companions<WH07464> that follow<WH0310> her shall be brought<WH0935><WTH8716> unto thee.
With gladness<WH08057> and rejoicing<WH01524> shall they be brought<WH02986><WTH8714>: they shall enter<WH0935><WTH8799> into the king's<WH04428> palace<WH01964>.
Instead of thy fathers<WH01> shall be thy children<WH01121>, whom thou mayest make<WH07896><WTH8799> princes<WH08269> in all the earth<WH0776>.

I will make thy name<WH08034> to be remembered<WH02142><WTH8686> in all<WH01755> generations<WH01755>: therefore shall the people<WH05971> praise<WH03034><WTH8686> thee for ever<WH05769> and ever<WH05703>.<CM>
